briefing.summary: Previously declared a PAN-PAN for an oil pressure indication. After secondary checks, the issue is resolved (faulty gauge confirmed). Need to cancel the urgency call.

challenge.prompt: Cancel the previously-declared urgency with Brisbane Centre.
challenge.expectedText: Brisbane Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, cancel PAN PAN, situation resolved.

elements.label: Cancel phrase
elements.hint: Use the explicit cancel phrase so Centre clears the urgency status on the frequency.

elements.label: Reason
elements.hint: Recommended but not strict — helps Centre brief SAR and other traffic.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.6: distress and urgency cancellations follow a specific format so the frequency returns to normal. Use 'cancel PAN PAN' or 'cancel MAYDAY' as appropriate.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Cancellation procedures for distress and urgency calls.
